package.description: CosyVoice：你只管说，就可得到恰当得体的表达，自动整理，一键成文。

en-US.description: CosyVoice: just speak — get polished, well-phrased text, auto-organized and ready in one tap.
en-US.longDescription: CosyVoice is an AI-powered voice input app from Alibaba Tongyi that turns speech into polished text. It provides real-time high-quality speech-to-text that strips filler words and repetitions, recognizes spoken self-corrections such as "no wait, change that to", auto-formats rambling speech into numbered lists, tables, or outlines, and drafts complete emails or meeting invites from a single spoken instruction. It understands Shanghainese, Cantonese, Sichuanese and more, transcribing them into standard Mandarin, and offers multilingual translation, smart speaker separation, smart summaries, and smart to-do tracking.

zh-CN.description: CosyVoice：你只管说，就可得到恰当得体的表达，自动整理，一键成文。
zh-CN.longDescription: CosyVoice 是阿里通义推出的智能语音输入应用，支持实时高质量语音转文本，自动过滤“嗯、啊、那个”等口语化填充词与重复词；识别“不对，改成…”等口语自我修正并自动应用；将散乱口述自动整理为编号列表、表格或大纲；一句话指令即可生成完整邮件、会议邀请等成稿。支持上海话、粤语、四川话等多种方言转写为标准普通话，并提供多语言翻译、智能区分发言人、智能总结摘要、智能待办跟踪等功能。
zh-CN.name: CosyVoice
